approach.summary: Forward raw webhook values through an injected Transformer with ordered optional Observer notifications.
rules: Delegate the raw input exactly once without normalization, coercion, retries, or panic recovery.
Return the original result and error unchanged, including a result returned with an error.
Call Started before Transform for a non-nil observer and Finished only on success.
Use only the Go standard library.

title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
